d.en: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this strategic roguelite tower defense adventure!
d.zh: 《Emberward》是一款着重于迷宫建造与独特砲塔组合的 Roguelite 塔防游戏。利用各种形状的方块规划怪物路线，搭配不同砲塔与神器守护脆弱的火源！

This is the best tower defense since Warcraft 3(classic) bnet glory days of my youth. Truly a gem of gems when it comes to this genre and I've really enjoyed it. I forsee 100+ hours on this game in due time. …

This would be such a better game if it could only restrain itself. Less blocks to build the maze with, less enemies each wave, less money for turrets. And by lessening the numbers gave more weight to each of those elements, more strategy. …
